what: Single authorized real-API verification through the existing guarded client.
fixture: synthetic only: 10 invented one-line snippets about a counter; no repository source, no personal data, no secrets, no conversation content was sent
authorization: one call only; retries forced to 0 via JEV_MAX_RETRIES=0
authNote: we set no Authorization and no x-api-key; the cloud environment API credential is attached by the agent proxy after the request leaves the VM. The key value is not present in this process and was never read.

firstAttemptBeforeFix.cause: node's built-in fetch ignores HTTPS_PROXY unless NODE_USE_ENV_PROXY is set before process start, so the request bypassed the agent proxy; the agent proxy is also what attaches the credential, so the call could never have authenticated
firstAttemptBeforeFix.fix: resolveMode now refuses a real call when HTTPS_PROXY is set and NODE_USE_ENV_PROXY is not
